sentences.japanese: 彼女は黒い帽子をかぶっていた。
sentences.english: She was wearing a black hat.

sentences.japanese: 家はねこが２匹います。１匹は白で、もう１匹は黒です。
sentences.english: We have two cats; one is white, and the other is black.

sentences.japanese: 家には２匹の犬がいる。１匹は黒で、もう１匹は白である。
sentences.english: We have two dogs. One is black and the other is white.

sentences.japanese: 煙突から黒い煙が出てきた。
sentences.english: Black smoke came out of the chimney.
